newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed stronger against the dollar on Tuesday on the mark's gains versus the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The forint finished at 195.80/85 to the dollar, compared with 196.18/23 at midday and the opening 196.25/30.
At the close, the forint was six pips below the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level, unchanged from midday but firmer than in the morning when the gap was eight to 10 pips.
Turnover was low in the afternoon after heavy trading in the morning on deals linked with end-month position closings of commercial banks, dealers said.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
